source_paper.title: A telomere-to-telomere reference genome assembly of tomato cultivar Heinz 1706
source_paper.reported_old_assembly: SL5.0; HiFi plus Hi-C; 801.8 Mb; 31 gaps; 21 missing telomeres; 45S rDNA information absent
source_paper.reported_new_assembly: SL-T2T; ONT-based; 831.45 Mb; all 24 telomeres; chromosome 2 45S rDNA remains the stated exception
source_paper.donor_warning: small differences up to 46 kb may reflect heterozygosity from mixed seeds or sample differences between ONT and HiFi sequencing

eligibility_decision.blocking_reason: the primary paper explicitly allows ONT-versus-HiFi sample differences and mixed-seed heterozygosity
eligibility_decision.why_cultivar_name_is_insufficient: a shared cultivar label does not establish the same plant, BioSample or DNA extraction
eligibility_decision.permitted_future_use: same-cultivar Tier B descriptive context under separately frozen scoring rules
eligibility_decision.prohibited_use: donor-matched truth or primary assembly-collapse accuracy validation

evidence_boundary: source eligibility audit only; no large download, TandemX run, accuracy estimate or resource measurement
